answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence scales with capital commitment. This creates a pigment of trust in the network's integrity. An attacker cannot simply raven through new identities; they must acquire significant stake, which is akin to finding a rare opal in scarcity. This ensures the cost of an attack is proportional to the total value secured, rendering the fabrication of sybil identities economically irrational and technically unsustainable.
